==Dialogue==
;Before completing [[Tihark Orchard]]
:''"I made my first fortune in the theatre, but now it's gotten so commercial."''
:''"Let me just say one word. Are you ready? [[Chitin Fragment|Chitin]]! That's the future. Shhh. Don't tell anyone else."''
:''"Nightfall will never happen, but that gives me an idea for a great sales gimmick."''
:''"Those [[Kourna]]ns are so serious, but their coin spends just the same."''
:''"What I wouldn't give to have the Kournan army food contract."''

;During Tihark Orchard
:''"Did you hear the [[Istan]]i attacked Kourna? How shameful."''
:''"Happy holiday. May [[Lyssa]] grant all your greatest dreams!"''
:''"Have you ever seen a body like this before in your life?"''
:''"Have you heard? The Kournans are on the way to protect us from the Istani invaders."''
:''"I drank what?"''
:''"I have been having strange dreams lately. One is of impending evil threatening the land. The other was even more odd."''
:''"I love [[Vabbi]] this time of year. All other lands pale in comparison."''
:''"I've heard strange stories of the undead living in [[The Desolation|the desolation]] to the west of Vabbi."''
:''"Lyssa bless you, friend."''
:''"May Lyssa's embrace hold you for the rest of your days."''
:''"May the blessings of Lyssa be upon you."''
:''"[[Prince Ahmtur the Mighty]] is the true defender of Vabbi, not those other two cowards."''
:''"[[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] must be the richest man in all of Vabbi. He's probably the fattest, too."''
:''"They say the riches of Vabbi are locked away in a great [[Hidden City of Ahdashim|hidden city]], yet no one knows where."''
:''"Was it a dream where you see yourself standing in sort of sun-god robes on a pyramid, with a thousand naked women screaming and throwing little pickles at you?"''

;After completing Tihark Orchard
:''"I'm glad the party was crashed. I wasn't even invited."''
:''"I'm tired from too much partying."''
:''"Oh, yes, I was at the party, and I saw everything."''
:''"The guards at that party were terrible! Everything was their fault."''
:''"[[Varesh]] is hunting the [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]], but who is hunting Varesh?"''

;After completiing [[Dasha Vestibule]]
:''"Bokka and [[Prince Mehtu the Wise|Mehtu]] are cowards. They should be taken to the center of the city and whipped."''
:''"Do you really think Varesh might attack Vabbi?"''
:''"I've heard the streets of Kourna are lined with gold and Varesh is looking for more."''
:''"Mehtu and Bokka, feeling to the Hidden City? Scandalous! They could have at least taken me."''
:''"You stink of travel. Go bathe before approaching me again."''

;After completiing [[Dzagonur Bastion]]
:''"Have you heard about the attack on the [[Citadel of Dzagon]]? How exiting"''
:''"I'm throwing a gala this weekend at my summer estate. You're not invited."''
:''"You must be kidding. Another war? Already? We haven't finished paying for the last one."''
:''"This color is all the rage in [[Istan]], I understand."''
:''"Who is this 'Ahmtur the Mighty' and why hasn't he been to any of my parties?"''

;After completing [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]]
:''"Nightfall! But I haven't anything to wear!"''
:''"The stories of Nightfall are told to children to scare them into bed. I'm not afraid."''
:''"They destroyed the [[Sebelkeh Basilica|Temple of Lyssa]]! How barbaric!"
:''"Temples are sacred places, and I hope the gods punish those who despoiled it."''
:''"Varesh may have fled, but the damage she wrought remains."''

;After completing [[Ruins of Morah]]
:''"Get me out of [[Elona]] and away from Nightfall! I can pay. Whatever it takes."''
:''"I didn't want to believe in Nightfall. But there's no escaping it now."''
:''"My poor children. I'm so afraid for them."''
:''"The darkness. The darkness. It's everywhere. Get it off me!"''
:''"The world ending and demons everywhere.... It's all too much for me."''

;After completing [[Abaddon's Gate]]
:''"Did you know that I knew [[Kormir]] before she was a goddess? She came to one of my parties, once."''
:''"Elona's sun rises again thanks to your bravery. Now can you do something about the monsters on my estate?"''
:''"Ew. Don't you ever bathe?"''
:''"Things are so much better now! Thank you!"''
:''"Varesh should have known better than to fight the Sunspears."''

== Notes ==
* In the [[Tihark Orchard]] mission, these NPCs are called "Vabbi Noble".

== Trivia ==
* The line ''"Was it a dream where you see yourself standing in sort of sun-god robes on a pyramid, with a thousand naked women screaming and throwing little pickles at you?"'' is from the film ''[[w:Real Genius|Real Genius]]''.
* The line ''"Let me just say one word. Are you ready? Chitin!"'' is a reference to ''[[w:The Graduate|The Graduate]]''.
